rule: Only explicit operator-approved offers may override the default candidate approval gate.

approved.name: Agentic Commerce Readiness Audit
approved.problem: Identify the highest-impact barriers preventing a merchant from being discoverable, understandable, and transactable by commerce agents.
approved.input: Customer-provided catalog, commerce, policy, and checkout context sufficient to assess agentic-commerce readiness.
approved.output: 0-100 readiness score, five-dimension summary, top three revenue-impacting blockers, and evidence-backed next actions.
approved.deliverable: Agentic Commerce Readiness Audit report with score, evidence-backed blockers, and prioritized next actions.
approved.target_buyer: Merchants and commerce teams preparing products or services for machine-readable agent commerce.
approved.eligibility: Customer must provide sufficient public or customer-supplied commerce inputs; no credentials are required.
approved.refund_rules: Apply the published checkout policy; delivery is not represented as complete before verified fulfillment.
